question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summary : The greatest poet in Bangla literature is Rabindranath Tagore. After imparting house education he was sent to school for institutional education where he could not set his mind to study. Later he was sent to London to sludy Law, but he studied literature these and returned home. Then he began to write in all branches of hiterature. And, for his outstanding performance, he was honoured with the Nobel Prize.
